introHtml: RTIC lunch bags, boxes, and totes are built with the same roto-molded insulation that keeps ice frozen for days, making them ideal for outdoor crews, field service teams, and safety managers who need reliable food storage. Unlike standard soft-sided coolers, RTIC products withstand job site abuse and retain temperature for hours. Add your company logo through screen printing or embroidery for a rugged branded giveaway that employees will actually use daily.
